prompts.title: Recent form: wins, draws and losses
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles, safe from graphics. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for LASK Linz, slate #8ca6bf for Liverpool FC. Editorial variant: kinetic typography sequence. Open on charcoal field with faint vertical rhythm lines. Spanish labels Victorias, Empates, Derrotas enter one by one in condensed uppercase, warm white, snapping to a percussive beat. Team names LASK Linz and Liverpool FC appear as opposing columns, lime against slate. Words pulse, scale, and overlap without axes or numbers. A quick rhythmic emphasis kicks on the largest word cluster, then the frame cuts to a tight macro of the team names. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Statistical variant: grouped count bars. Layout is a vertical chart with two team rows. Common scale is a shared zero baseline across all categories. X-axis categories are Spanish labels Victorias, Empates, Derrotas; Y-axis unit is partidos. Each category has paired bars: lime for LASK Linz, slate for Liverpool FC. Values use placeholders {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Sample and source annotation sits under the chart: source Bzzoiro, muestra {{home.n}} y {{away.n}}, with separate labels for each team to expose any unequal samples. Temporal stages: first axis draws in, then bars grow from zero baseline left to right, then labels fade. Entry animation: bars rise with a slight overshoot. Main comparison: win, draw, loss counts side by side. Emphasis: the tallest bar in each team row glows lime or slate, while smaller bars stay muted. Camera movement: slow vertical push from baseline to top. Transition: whip-pan blur into next scene. Exit: bars collapse to baseline and labels dissolve. Keep hierarchy legible and one focal point per beat.

prompts.title: Goals: for and against
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for LASK Linz, slate #8ca6bf for Liverpool FC. Editorial variant: illustrative football pitch and ball path. A stylised pitch drawn in thin warm-white lines on charcoal, with lime and slate goal areas. A ball trail animates from centre to both goals, splitting into two paths: one toward LASK Linz goal, one toward Liverpool FC goal. Spanish labels Goles a favor and Goles recibidos appear as floating tags. No axes, no numbers, no sample claims, no invented match events. The ball path uses rhythmic arcs and speed ramps to create attacking energy. Emphasis is on the ball crossing the goal line, with a brief lime or slate flash. Camera movement: top-down pitch view slowly rotates and zooms. Transition: ball exits frame as a motion streak. Exit: pitch lines fade to charcoal. Statistical variant: paired bars for both teams. Chart type is a vertical paired bar chart. Layout: two clusters, LASK Linz and Liverpool FC, each with two bars: Goles a favor in lime, Goles recibidos in slate. Common scale is a shared zero baseline with unit goles. Values use placeholders {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}. Spanish labels sit directly on bars: Goles a favor, Goles recibidos. Source and sample annotation is placed under the chart: source Bzzoiro, muestra attached to {{home.gf}} and {{away.gf}}. Temporal stages: axis appears, then first cluster grows, then second cluster grows. Entry animation: bars extend upward from baseline with a ball-roll easing. Main comparison: goals for versus goals against for each team. Emphasis: the larger bar in each pair pulses, while the smaller bar stays matte. Camera movement: slow lateral drift across the paired bars. Transition: ball streak wipes into next scene. Exit: bars shrink to baseline, labels fade. Maintain one focal point and legible Spanish labels.

prompts.title: Clean sheets: defensive counts
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for LASK Linz, slate #8ca6bf for Liverpool FC. Editorial variant: defensive energy and stylised shield. A large geometric shield forms in the centre, built from warm-white outlines. Inside, two team halves appear: lime side for LASK Linz, slate side for Liverpool FC. Spanish labels Arcos en cero and Partidos float as rhythmic tags. The shield pulses with each blocked-shot energy beat, but no invented saves or match events. Motion is tight, low, and resilient. Emphasis is on the shield locking into place. Camera movement: slow push through the shield outline. Transition: shield edge wipes frame. Exit: shield fractures into particles and fades. Statistical variant: count comparison without converting counts into rates. Chart type is a horizontal count bar pair on a shared zero baseline. Layout: two rows, LASK Linz and Liverpool FC. Each row shows a bar for Arcos en cero in lime or slate, with unit partidos. Spanish labels are Arcos en cero on the bar and Partidos on the axis. Values use placeholders {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. Source and sample annotation is essential: source Bzzoiro, muestra {{home.n}} y {{away.n}}. Do not convert counts into rates. Temporal stages: baseline draws, then LASK bar grows, then Liverpool bar grows. Entry animation: bars slide from left with a defensive block ease. Main comparison: clean sheet counts side by side. Emphasis: the larger count bar glows, the smaller remains matte. Camera movement: slight tilt from baseline to labels. Transition: horizontal wipe into next scene. Exit: bars retract to zero and labels dissolve. Keep labels in Spanish and hierarchy clear.

prompts.title: Head-to-head: historical duel
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for LASK Linz, slate #8ca6bf for Liverpool FC. Editorial variant: visual duel. Two team names enter from opposite edges as large condensed type. LASK Linz in lime and Liverpool FC in slate collide at centre, creating a split-screen tension. Spanish labels Cruces previos, Victorias, Empates appear as kinetic stamps. No axes, no numbers, no sample claims, no invented match events. Motion is confrontational: speed lines, impact frames, quick push-pull. Emphasis is on the central clash. Camera movement: rapid alternating close-ups of each side. Transition: hard cut on impact. Exit: both names recoil and fade. Statistical variant: available historical win and draw counts. Chart type is a stacked or grouped count bar with a shared zero baseline and unit partidos. Layout: a single horizontal bar for Cruces previos with segments for Victorias LASK Linz, Empates, and Victorias Liverpool FC. Spanish labels are Victorias LASK Linz, Empates, Victorias Liverpool FC, Cruces previos. Values use placeholders {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.draws}}, {{h2h.awayWins}}, with total {{h2h.total}}. Source and sample annotation: source Bzzoiro, muestra {{h2h.total}}. Add a clear Spanish note that historical data is not a forecast. Temporal stages: total bar draws, then segments fill, then labels resolve. Entry animation: segments slide in from left and right. Main comparison: historical wins and draws. Emphasis: the largest segment pulses, others stay muted. Camera movement: slow push from total label to segments. Transition: segment wipe into next scene. Exit: bar collapses to zero and labels fade. Keep one focal point and legible Spanish labels.

prompts.title: Synthesis: grounded statistical tension
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for LASK Linz, slate #8ca6bf for Liverpool FC. Editorial variant: team reveals and narrative emphasis. Open on charcoal with two abstract team blocks. LASK Linz reveal uses lime edges; Liverpool FC reveal uses slate edges. Spanish labels Derrotas, Victorias, Arcos en cero appear as story beats, not as invented events. Motion builds a tension: one side shows setbacks, the other shows control, but no predictive language is used. Emphasis is on the final paired reveal. Camera movement: slow dolly across both blocks. Transition: light sweep between team colours. Exit: blocks slide apart and fade. Statistical variant: compatible available facts in the same unit, partidos. Chart type is a paired count bar comparison on a shared zero baseline. Layout: left cluster LASK Linz shows Derrotas; right cluster Liverpool FC shows Victorias and Arcos en cero. Spanish labels are Derrotas LASK Linz, Victorias Liverpool FC, Arcos en cero LASK Linz, Arcos en cero Liverpool FC, Partidos. Values use placeholders {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{home.clean}}, {{away.clean}}. Source and sample annotation: source Bzzoiro, muestra {{home.n}} y {{away.n}}. No published model estimate is supplied in the catalog, so labels must distinguish these as historical counts only; no predictive claims. Temporal stages: baseline, then LASK bar, then Liverpool bars. Entry animation: bars rise from zero with a measured ease. Main comparison: LASK losses against Liverpool wins and clean sheets. Emphasis: the contrast between the two clusters. Camera movement: slight zoom to the tension point between bars. Transition: cross-dissolve into final title. Exit: bars fade to charcoal. Keep one focal point and legible Spanish labels.
